name: PDF Thumbnails
description: Automatically generates cover thumbnails for PDF files in your Jellyfin library by rendering the first page of each PDF. Supports configurable render resolution (DPI) and thumbnail padding mode.
overview: Generates thumbnail images from the first page of PDF files.

versions.changelog:
Feature: configurable output image format (PNG, WebP or JPEG) instead of always PNG
- Feature: optional second encode engine ("Skia + ImageSharp") exposing WebP encoding method (0-6) and near-lossless pre-processing not available via Skia alone
- Feature: configurable image quality (1-100) for lossy encoding (WebP lossy / JPEG)
- Feature: configurable lossless compression effort (0-100) for PNG and WebP lossless
- Feature: configurable JPEG chroma subsampling (4:2:0 / 4:2:2 / 4:4:4)
- Feature: configurable maximum thumbnail resolution (longest side cap) with presets and a custom value, independent of render DPI
- Config page now shows only the options relevant to the selected format/engine, and displays the bundled ImageSharp version
- JPEG output automatically disables transparent padding since JPEG has no alpha channel

Feature: extract the embedded image directly when a PDF's first page is just a single full-page image (e.g. a scanned cover), instead of rasterizing it
- Pages that also contain text or other content are still rendered normally so nothing is lost
- Extracted images are rotated according to the page's /Rotate value to avoid upside-down covers
Fix: rendered thumbnails now embed pixel-density (DPI) metadata so image viewers report the configured render resolution instead of always defaulting to 96 DPI
- Increase maximum configurable render resolution from 600 to 1000 DPI

Fix: avoid blocking Jellyfin's thread pool during PDF rendering
- GetImageResponse now offloads synchronous PDF rendering (PDFtoImage/SkiaSharp) to Task.Run so ASP.NET thread pool threads are never blocked
- EnsureThumbnailExistsAsync is now properly async (was fake-async, blocking caller thread)
- PDF rendering now respects CancellationToken; requests cancelled by Jellyfin abort early
- Fix: pageStream MemoryStream is now properly disposed after use

Fix: SkiaSharp version conflict causing fatal crash
- Downgrade PDFtoImage to 5.0.0 (uses SkiaSharp 3.116.x compatible with Jellyfin)
- Exclude SkiaSharp from plugin bundle; use Jellyfin's copy to avoid cross-context type conflicts
- Use byte array decode path to eliminate SKManagedStream finalizer risk

Initial release
- PDF first-page thumbnail generation
- Configurable render resolution (DPI)
- Configurable thumbnail padding mode (white, transparent, no padding)
